cap_definition: Primary caps are a fraction of each zone's total 2050 generation in efix_tier_200 (all PWR technologies except PWRTRN). The tight sensitivity uses the same fraction of each zone's reference 2050 PWRBIO output. Caps are held constant in every year 2021-2070.

efix_tier_200.label: Post-fix $200/t reference: tiered supply, hydro capped

pwrbio_cap10_windint3_tier200.label: 10% of zone reference 2050 generation, $200/t, hydro capped, +$3/GJ wind

pwrbio_cap5_tier200.label: 5% of zone reference 2050 generation, $200/t, hydro capped

pwrbio_cap5_windint3_tier200.label: 5% of zone reference 2050 generation, $200/t, hydro capped, +$3/GJ wind

pwrbio_cap5ofbio_tier200.label: tight sensitivity: 5% of zone reference 2050 PWRBIO output, $200/t, hydro capped

wind_int3_refhydro_tier200.label: control: +$3/GJ wind with the reference run's hydro caps and no PWRBIO cap

corrected_emission_factors.basis: fuel-input factor x plant InputActivityRatio (output basis)
